tagline: Mods, survival and a Minecraft-style experience for OpenVoxel, without touching the game files.
home.lead: Survival, crafting, skins and mods for OpenVoxel. It runs through the official launcher and never patches the game.
home.paths.title: What do you want to do?
home.paths.sub: Pick a path: each one takes a few minutes to set up.
home.paths.play.title: Play with mods
home.paths.play.text: Survival, crafting, chests, skins with both layers, chat colors and the mods you install.
home.paths.host.title: Host a server
home.paths.host.text: The official dedicated server with an interactive console, colors, utility commands and plugins.
home.paths.host.steps: Put the official server jar in server/
Drop plugins in mods/ and run start.bat
home.paths.dev.title: Create mods
home.paths.dev.text: A small Java API for commands, blocks with ids, items, recipes, HUD and events. Gradle template included.
home.features.title: Everything you expect, in OpenVoxel
home.features.survival.title: Survival & Creative
home.features.survival.text: Hunger, armor, tools with mining times, drops, mobs, fall damage and creative flight.
home.features.crafting.title: Crafting & blocks
home.features.crafting.text: 2x2 and 3x3 crafting with a recipe book, chests, beds, wall torches. Blocks have namespaced ids.
home.features.skins.title: Skins & cosmetics
home.features.skins.text: 64x64 / 128x128 skins with both layers, Steve/Alex arms, capes and elytra wings.
home.features.chat.title: Chat & controls
home.features.chat.text: Colors with & and &#hex, command suggestions, history, Tab player list, rebindable keys.
home.features.api.title: Mod API
home.features.api.text: Commands, translations, config, items, recipes, blocks with ids, HUD drawing and engine events.
home.features.server.title: Server plugins
home.features.server.text: Console, colors and admin commands on the official server; plugins use the official API.
home.code.title: Your first mod in a few lines
home.code.text: Mods are plain Java jars dropped into instance/mods. No game sources, no patching, no Maven setup.
home.code.points: Blocks and items with ids like mymod:ruby_block
Translations, per-mod config and sounds built in
home.betaBanner.title: Try {{v}}
home.betaBanner.text: Pre-release for testing, client and server. It can have bugs; the stable download stays the default.
home.betaBanner.items: ModLoader blocks render as real blocks and sync on servers
download.title: Download
download.sub: Ready-to-use ZIPs with launch scripts for Windows and Linux. In the official launcher pick version {{launcher}}.
download.betaNote: Beta builds are for testing new features and may contain bugs. Back up your worlds.
download.jarOnly: Only the jar (to update an existing install)
download.client.title: Client
download.client.text: Play OpenVoxel with the ModLoader: survival, crafting, skins, chat and your mods.
download.client.steps.windows: In the launcher select 0.0.8-Debug and press PLAY
download.client.steps.linux: Unzip ModLoader-Client next to the launcher
Run ./launch.sh (set OPENVOXEL_HOME if the launcher is elsewhere)
In the launcher select 0.0.8-Debug and press PLAY
download.client.contents: The loader jar, launch.bat / launch.ps1 / launch.sh, and the instance folder: mods, config, lang, resourcepacks, sounds, music.
download.server.title: Server
download.server.text: Run the official dedicated server with a console, colors, admin commands and plugins.
download.server.noBeta: The server has no beta yet: the stable server works with the beta client.
download.server.steps.windows: Double-click start.bat and type help in the console
download.server.steps.linux: Run ./start.sh and type help in the console
download.server.contents: The core plugin jar, start.bat / start.ps1 / start.sh, server.properties.yml and the mods, plugins, server and logs folders.
download.req.title: Requirements
download.req.items: OpenVoxel installed with the official launcher
Java is bundled with the game
To make mods: JDK 11 or newer
mods.sub: The loader, example mods and templates. More mods will appear here as the community publishes them.
mods.author: Author
mods.install: Client mods go in ModLoader-Client/instance/mods; server plugins in ModLoader-Server/mods.
mods.submit: Made a mod? Open an issue or pull request on GitHub to add it to this list.
content.docsSub: Reference for players, server owners and mod developers.
content.tutorialsSub: Step-by-step guides, from your first mod to server plugins.
footer.about: Unofficial modding layer for OpenVoxel. Runs through the official launcher; the game and launcher files are never modified.
footer.legal: OpenVoxel ModLoader is a community project, not affiliated with the OpenVoxel developers. MIT licensed.
changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.sub: Every ModLoader release and what changed. Pre-releases are betas for testing.
servers.title: Run a ModLoader server
servers.sub: Permissions, operators, game modes, a configurable tab list and the admin commands you expect, on the official OpenVoxel dedicated server.
servers.f.perms.title: Permissions & operators
servers.f.perms.text: /op and /deop, a node for every command, defaults for everyone in permissions.yml, /perms check.
servers.f.gamemode.title: Server-side game modes
servers.f.gamemode.text: With the ModLoader client the server decides who can use creative; modes are remembered per player.
servers.f.tab.title: Tab list
servers.f.tab.text: Header, footer and name format with placeholders and permission prefixes in tablist.yml.
servers.f.whitelist.title: Whitelist, slots, warps
servers.f.whitelist.text: Whitelist, max players, join message, world spawn and warps.
servers.f.api.title: Permission API
servers.f.api.text: Permissions.has(player, node) for your plugins, and a provider interface for permission systems.
servers.f.luckperms.title: LuckPerms (in progress)
servers.f.luckperms.text: Groups, tracks, prefixes and a web editor through a LuckPerms port for OpenVoxel.
servers.how.title: Getting started
servers.how.steps: Download the server ZIP and add the official server jar
Start it and type op YourName in the console
Give everyone the nodes you want in plugins/ModLoader/permissions.yml
Edit tablist.yml and the gameplay section of server.properties.yml
servers.nodes.title: Main permission nodes
servers.roadmap.title: Coming next for servers
servers.roadmap.items: LuckPerms for OpenVoxel (groups, tracks, web editor)
Synced chest contents and ModLoader blocks for everyone
Native blocks registered on client and server
A proxy (BungeeCord/Velocity style) to link several servers
